evals.name: plan-refunds-python
evals.prompt: In {repo}, my branch `wip` is a work-in-progress with a couple of things mixed into it. I want to land the refund feature onto `integration` as small reviewable PRs. Plan the PRs for me — don't create any branches yet. Save the plan to {outputs}/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: A slice plan for the refund feature only: the payment client standalone at the bottom, domain+repository+service by capability with every domain/repository method alongside its caller, handlers+routes+wiring+env last; newsletter hunks excluded; count_refunds flagged as uncalled; stops before building.

evals.name: build-refunds-python
evals.prompt: In {repo}, pull the refund feature out of `wip` into stacked PRs onto `integration`. I already agree to whatever split you think is right, so don't stop to ask me — plan it and build it. There's no GitHub here: push the branches to origin, and instead of opening PRs write each PR's title, base branch and description to {outputs}/prs.md. Save your plan to {outputs}/plan.md as well.
evals.expected_output: Branches pushed to origin forming one linear stack off integration; each branch passes `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`; the tip matches wip for refund-only files and matches wip minus newsletter hunks for shared files; no newsletter code anywhere in the stack; prs.md lists each PR with its base.

evals.name: plan-reminders-typescript
evals.prompt: {repo} is our billing service. The `wip` branch has the invoice reminders feature plus some unrelated dark-mode UI work. Plan how to split just the reminders into stacked PRs onto `integration`. Plan only — save it to {outputs}/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: A plan in the repo's own vocabulary (entities/db/integrations/services/routes/jobs/container): the Twilio SMS client standalone at the bottom carrying the twilio dependency; entity+store+service for reminders with every entity/store method beside its caller; the cron job, the route, container and server wiring together last; the dark-mode files and the color dependency excluded from package.json hunks.
